did: Built the last piece of a game's bite list, GWB14 D15, on the slow-lane branch claude/gwb14-moments, with no pull request yet. When Takes is opened on one game, the phone reads that game's moments from home and shows each big one that no bite was said about as a dimmed row among the bites, in game order: No bite, the quarter and clock, the scenario and the play. It reads again every minute while the game is on. Takes got one generic slot for what a topic holds with no take, so a week's unanswered questions can use it next. A fresh review found one bug, a moment shown as missed when its bite was on a page not read yet, and it is fixed. The whole www test suite and the phone fit sweep pass.

calls.title: Takes gets one generic slot for what a topic holds with no take
options: A generic gaps prop placed among the takes by time
A prop for game moments alone
A separate list of missed moments above or below the bites
calls.why: A game's moments are one case of a topic's own record that takes are about; a week's unanswered questions are the next, and they need no new list.
calls.undo: Drop the gaps prop from the Takes page, and it lists takes alone as before (C1022).

calls.title: A game's moments are read as the app's other home reads are
options: A query keyed by the game's id, like Studio's Renders
A new hand-built state machine and runtime
calls.why: The query already keeps one game's late answer from standing for another's, so a second runtime would duplicate it. The coordinator agreed.
calls.undo: Replace the query with a runtime in lib/game-moments (C1023).

calls.title: Missed moments show dimmed, while the game is on and once it is over
options: Dimmed rows, live and final, for the game the page opened on
Only once the game is final
For whichever game chip is picked
calls.why: A live game's missing bites are the ones still worth saying, and Game day only opens Takes on one game.
calls.undo: Remove the gaps prop on the Takes page; the row's words are in game-week's words (C1024).

left: The moments route's contract waits until the server branch and the route snapshot merge, in the order the coordinator set.
A bite only counts against its moment once home has matched it to a play, so a bite just said leaves its moment dimmed until then.
Only the game Takes opened on shows its moments; picking another game's chip there shows its bites alone.
One failed read stops the minute-by-minute refresh until a pull or a new visit.
